## Summary

Describe the user or engineering problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Authentication and row-level-security implications were reviewed

- [ ] Documentation, migrations, and environment examples were updated when needed
- [ ] No secrets, service-role keys, or private user data are included

## Visual changes

Include before/after screenshots or a short recording for interface changes.
